columns.name: CategoryId
columns.description: Unique category identifier. Field can be null.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Checklist item name. Field can be null.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Checklist item description. Field can be null.

columns.name: DescriptionIsHtml
columns.description: Indicates if the description is in HTML.

columns.name: DueDate
columns.description: Date the item is due. Field can be null.

columns.name: ScheduleId
columns.description: Indicates the schedule to which this checklist belongs. Field can be null.

columns.name: SortOrder
columns.description: The order in which the checklist items are sorted.

columns.name: IsAutoChecked
columns.description: Indicates if the checklist item is automatically selected.

columns.name: LastModifiedUtc
columns.description: Last modified date/time (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: DateDeleted
columns.description: Date the item was deleted (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: DeletedBy
columns.description: User who deleted the checklist item. Field can be null.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the checklist item.
